descriptors.definition: A listed entity must provide advance notice to stock exchanges before its board convenes for financial results or specific corporate proposals. Different timeframes apply depending on whether the meeting discusses quarterly results, corporate actions like buybacks, or structural security alterations.
instrument_references: SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 Regulation 29
SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 Regulation 42
inclusion: Financial results considerations
Proposals for buybacks, delisting, fund raising, and bonus issues
Record date notifications for dividends and rights issues
exclusion: Routine board meetings without price-sensitive proposals
General operational discussions not requiring exchange disclosure
nearby_distinctions: Differs from annual compliance reports by requiring specific event-based advance scheduling rather than periodic year-end filings.

descriptors.definition: Listed entities are mandated to execute specific disclosures and report submissions at the conclusion of each financial year. These encompass submitting audited standalone financial results, dispatching annual reports to security holders, and filing corporate governance reports within designated statutory deadlines.
terminology: Statement on Impact of Audit Qualifications
instrument_references: SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 Regulation 33
SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 Regulation 34
SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 Regulation 36
inclusion: Submission of annual audited standalone financial results within 60 days
Distribution of annual reports to shareholders prior to the annual general meeting
Filing annual compliance reports on corporate governance
exclusion: Quarterly financial reporting obligations
Ad-hoc event-driven stock exchange intimations
nearby_distinctions: Unlike quarterly intimations, these compliances focus exclusively on comprehensive full-year financial performance, shareholder communications, and governance evaluations.

descriptors.definition: This framework governs the structural management practices of listed entities, particularly focusing on related party transactions and compliance reporting. It establishes precise definitions for related parties and transactions to safeguard corporate resources from improper transfers.
instrument_references: SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 Regulation 23
Companies Act, 2013 Section 2(76)
inclusion: Identification of promoters and significant equity holders as related parties
Approval processes for material related party contracts
Submission of quarterly and annual compliance reports
exclusion: Preferential issue of specified securities
Units issued by mutual funds listed on recognized stock exchanges
nearby_distinctions: Focuses on internal relationship governance and transaction approvals rather than external capital issuance rules.

descriptors.concept_name: Types Of Committees Under Lodr Regulations
descriptors.definition: Listed entities are required to establish specialized board committees, such as an audit committee, structured with independent directors and financial literacy requirements. These committees operate under specific mandates to oversee financial reporting, internal audits, and corporate governance functions.
instrument_references: SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 Regulation 18
Companies Act, 2013 Section 177
inclusion: Constitution of an audit committee with minimum three directors
Mandatory inclusion of financially literate members and a chairperson who is an independent director
Holding meetings at least four times annually with specified maximum gaps
exclusion: General executive management operations handled directly by whole-time directors
Non-statutory ad-hoc committees lacking formal regulatory oversight terms
nearby_distinctions: Distinguished from broader board management by its narrow focus on statutory audit oversight, financial review, and investigative powers.

descriptors.concept_name: Securities And Exchange Board Of India (Issue Of Capital And Disclosure Requirements) Regulations,
descriptors.definition: These regulations govern the issuance and offer of capital instruments by Indian companies to balance issuer development with investor protection. They classify capital issuances into categories such as public issues, rights issues, bonus issues, and private placements.
instrument_references: SEBI (Issue of Capital and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2018
inclusion: Initial public offers by unlisted issuers
Further public offers by listed issuers
Rights and composite issues to existing or new investors
exclusion: Secondary market trading transactions between investors
Unregulated private borrowing arrangements
nearby_distinctions: Focuses on primary market capital formation rules rather than continuous listing obligations.

descriptors.definition: Capital market regulations oversee primary security offerings to safeguard investors while facilitating corporate growth. Issuances are categorized structurally into public offerings, rights offerings, bonus allotments, and private placements.
instrument_references: SEBI (Issue of Capital and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2018
inclusion: Public issues targeting new market investors
Bonus issues funded from free reserves or share premium accounts
exclusion: Secondary market share transfers
Debt instruments devoid of capital raising context
nearby_distinctions: Provides foundational definitions for issue classifications rather than specific eligibility metrics.

descriptors.definition: The regulations provide standardized terminology for core market mechanisms used during capital raises. These terms outline specific procedural processes like price discovery, instrument characteristics, and post-listing stabilization options.
instrument_references: SEBI (Issue of Capital and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2018 Regulation 2
Companies Act, 2013
inclusion: Definitions for book building and convertible debt instruments
Explanations of green shoe price stabilization options
Classification of offer documents like red herring prospectuses and letters of offer
exclusion: Operational guidelines for secondary market brokers
Internal corporate governance codes
nearby_distinctions: Establishes precise definitional boundaries for transactional terms used across capital issue chapters.

descriptors.definition: The regulations govern various primary market activities undertaken by unlisted and listed issuers, including initial public offerings, rights issues, and preferential allotments. Certain specific issue types or transactions under takeover rules are explicitly excluded from their scope.
instrument_references: SEBI (Issue of Capital and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2018 Regulation 3
SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011
inclusion: Initial public offers by unlisted issuers
Rights issues of specified monetary thresholds by listed issuers
Preferential issues and qualified institutions placements
exclusion: Securities issued under specific exclusionary clauses of takeover regulations
Small rights issues below statutory monetary thresholds requiring only board filing
nearby_distinctions: Determines the jurisdictional boundary of the ICDR regulations over specific types of capital market issuances.

descriptors.concept_name: Initial Public Offer On Main Board Eligibility Requirements [Regulation 4-8A]
descriptors.definition: An issuer must satisfy specific reference date conditions and clear background checks to qualify for a main board initial public offering. Entities or promoters barred from capital markets, wilful defaulters, or those with outstanding unauthorized convertible securities are disqualified.
instrument_references: SEBI (Issue of Capital and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2018 Regulation 4
SEBI (Issue of Capital and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2018 Regulation 5
inclusion: Verification of eligibility conditions as of draft and final offer document filing dates
Restrictions on issuers or promoters facing regulatory debarment
Exceptions for employee stock options and fully paid-up convertible securities
exclusion: Completed past debarment periods where penalties have expired
Compliant employee stock option plans structured under applicable accounting standards
nearby_distinctions: Focuses on background integrity and structural disqualifications rather than financial quantitative thresholds.

descriptors.concept_name: Entities Not Eligible To Make An Initial Public Offer (Regulation 5): Under Following Circumstances—
descriptors.definition: Issuers are barred from launching initial public offerings if key stakeholders face capital market prohibitions, willful default classifications, or fugitive economic offender statuses. Additionally, outstanding unauthorized options or convertible securities prevent offering qualification unless specific exceptions apply.
instrument_references: SEBI (Issue of Capital and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2018 Regulation 5
inclusion: Entities with promoters or directors debarred by regulatory boards
Borrowers classified as willful defaulters
Issuers carrying active unauthorized convertible options
exclusion: Expired past debarments
Fully paid convertible securities converted prior to prospectus filing
nearby_distinctions: Targets compliance and character disqualifications rather than financial performance metrics.

descriptors.concept_name: Eligibility Requirements For An Initial Public Offer (Regulation 6)
descriptors.definition: An issuer must fulfill quantitative thresholds regarding net tangible assets, operating profits, and net worth across preceding years to qualify for an initial public offer. Alternative pathways through book building and institutional buyer allocations exist for issuers not meeting standard financial criteria.
instrument_references: SEBI (Issue of Capital and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2018 Regulation 6
inclusion: Maintenance of minimum net tangible assets and operating profits over three consecutive years
Name-change revenue composition rules
Alternative institutional allocation thresholds for non-qualifying issuers
exclusion: Issues structured entirely as offers for sale regarding monetary asset thresholds
Ordinary share listings under standard criteria when using differential voting rights
nearby_distinctions: Employs strict financial history benchmarks rather than qualitative background checks.

descriptors.definition: Issuers pursuing an initial public offer must satisfy procedural prerequisites, including stock exchange applications, depository agreements, and promoter share dematerialization. Furthermore, limits are imposed on the proportion of issue proceeds allocated toward general corporate purposes.
instrument_references: SEBI (Issue of Capital and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2018 Regulation 7
Companies Act, 2013 Schedule III
inclusion: Stock exchange application and depository contract execution
Compulsory dematerialization of promoter-held shares prior to filing
Restrictions capping general corporate purpose allocations at twenty-five percent
exclusion: Partly paid shares remaining uncalled or unforfeited
Unverified financing arrangements for project funding
nearby_distinctions: Governs procedural prerequisites and funding use caps rather than historical profit thresholds.
